name: CORAZA
recent: Coraza 在 2026 年 11 月 25 日公布截至 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，季度净利为 581 万令吉。期间公司因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，并有多名董事及主要人员在闭锁期内外进行股权交易。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，季度净利 581 万令吉。
因 ESOS 行使而发行新股，分别于 2026 年 10 月 12 日及 11 月 17 日上市。
执行主席 Lim Yook Yuen 于 2026 年 10 月 7 日出售 42,900 股。
risks: 执行主席 Lim Yook Yuen 于 2026 年 10 月 7 日出售 42,900 股。
主要人员 Chester Tang Chian Chiun 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日出售 50,000 股。
ESOS 行使持续发行新股，可能对每股盈利造成摊薄。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 5,104.5 万令吉，净利为 543.2 万令吉，净利率 10.6%。营收环比增长 15.7%，净利环比增长 25.1%；营收同比增长 20.1%，净利同比增长 69.8%。

recent_en: Coraza announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026, with quarterly net profit of RM5.81 million. During the period, the company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises, and several directors and principal officers conducted share transactions both during and outside the closed period.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with quarterly net profit of RM5.81 million.
Issued new shares due to ESOS exercises, listed on 12 October 2026 and 17 November 2026 respectively.
Executive Chairman Lim Yook Yuen disposed of 42,900 shares on 7 October 2026.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Lim Yook Yuen disposed of 42,900 shares on 7 October 2026.
Principal Officer Chester Tang Chian Chiun disposed of 50,000 shares on 5 October 2026.
Continued issuance of new shares from ESOS exercises may dilute earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM51.045 million and net profit was RM5.432 million, with a net margin of 10.6%. Revenue grew 15.7% QoQ and net profit grew 25.1% QoQ; revenue grew 20.1% YoY and net profit grew 69.8% YoY.
